new_init_availability.source: Existing confirmation manifest only; no simulator/state files or new-init outcomes opened
new_init_availability.boundary: The manifest records 50 official states for every task, so zero-based 36–40 are in range. It only hashes 30–35; no 36–40 identity verification or global unused-state audit has been performed.

multiplicity: Two-sided exact paired p-values and separate Holm40 task/Holm4 category screens are descriptive; they do not correct arbitrary posthoc regrouping or establish new confirmation.

limitations: The current frozen primary selection rule remains suite-only; this taxonomy does not amend it.
Any future comparison using these categories is exploratory unless independently preregistered before new evaluation outcomes.
Metadata categories alone cannot establish complementary paths, adaptive-selection value, causal layer specialization, or speedup.
Category sizes are unequal and strongly associated with suite identity; a future pooled category comparison must not silently attribute suite differences to semantics.
Official BDDL :init is a declared initialization constraint, not a fresh simulator measurement after settling.

reasons: Across 40 tasks, Jac is better on 8, MSE on 8, and 24 tie. The largest absolute task differences are only two net successes out of five (40 pp); task two-sided exact p-values are all at least 0.5 and Holm40 values are all 1.
The pre-existing semantic categories show only -10 pp, +10 pp, 0 pp, and -0.71 pp (Jac minus MSE); the two opposite 10 pp differences are just one or two net cases.
The +10 pp state-plus-placement effect becomes exactly zero after leaving out libero_10/task09; the -10 pp state-only effect becomes exactly zero after leaving out libero_goal/task07.
Category membership is strongly associated with suite and category sizes range from 2 to 28 tasks. These data do not isolate semantic specialization.
Selecting large individual task differences from these 40 tasks would create a new discovery hypothesis using current heldout data, not recover the original confirmation.
candidate_assessment.original_primary_and_registered_suppleme: The original Spatial/Long and registered Goal/Long preferences were not reproduced in the complete candidate pair; no grouping here replaces that finding.
